notes.notes:

Hey everyone!

The old demo has been pulled so a new one can be released come this October's Next Fest :)[/p][p]The new demo will be a different chunk of content that the last demo was, and should be much more representative of the game's current state.

notes.title: New Demo!
notes.notes:
Visual novel fest is here!
And to participate, Moonripple Lake is releasing a new demo.
It'll be available throughout the VNF, and be taken down after that.
So in case you haven't yet tried the game in the previous demo period, this is your chance :)

Hope you like it!

Have a great day,
BCG
